normative_source.title: WPA Rules of Heyball - Rules of Play, Effective 2025-08-16

status_semantics.IMPLEMENTED: Authoritative product-reachable automatic behavior has complete source and test evidence for the row.
status_semantics.PARTIAL: A proper subset or non-product foundation/authority exists; product-action rows cannot be IMPLEMENTED while gated off.
status_semantics.MISSING: Required fact, adjudication, action, state or test surface is absent.
status_semantics.PROCEDURAL_ONLY: The row requires referee/event procedure and is not fabricated as gameplay automation.
